Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi

The scheme provides income support of Rs. 6000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in three equal instalments. Eligible cultivators must typically be age 18 years or above and have recorded agricultural land. Aadhaar and land records are used at application time.

This page is an official MeitY / C-DAC Vikaspedia article used as a connector fixture. It repeats enough prose so the extractor treats the document as a substantial gazette snapshot rather than an empty JavaScript shell. Landholding farmer families receive the notified amount after verification against the official exclusion list published by the department.
